verdict.rationale: Oyster documents its own employee onboarding flow. Submitting an EOR employment kicks off onboarding and contract generation [oyster-docs-9], agreements are sent out for signature [oyster-docs-11], and the marketing site claims compliant onboarding in as little as 48 hours [oyster-docs-22]. Country-specific required fields come from rulesets [oyster-docs-10]. None of the evidence shows the new hire filling out a self-serve flow that collects tax, work-eligibility or bank details, so the support is thin. Missing for 10: evidence of W-4 collection, I-9/work-eligibility verification, bank/payment detail capture, a new-hire-facing self-serve portal completed before day one, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
